patch.explanation: The /leak handler appended a 10 MiB string to the module-level leak_store on every request, and nothing ever removed entries. Process memory therefore grew without bound until it neared the 128 MiB container limit. The fix removes the single leak_store.append(...) line, so the handler no longer retains anything between requests.
